title: Dexcom-G6-App will stop operation after May 12, 2021
body:
Hi folks, 
Iam using patched dexcom g6 app in version 1.5.1.5 dxcm3. After every start a notification will be shown that the program will cancel after May 12, 2021. 
( Creation of screenshot was denied)

How can I get a newer version they works with AAPS? The last version from [github](https://github.com/dexcomapp/dexcomapp/tree/master/2.4) is older than 2 years.

comments.body:
Here you can create a new one:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScD76G0Y-BlL4tZljaFkjlwuqhT83QlFM5v6ZEfO7gCU98iJQ/viewform

In this version you can also activate broadcast to XDrip, or AAPS, or both.
